questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.passage:
ⓐ It is a toothpaste that is [[advertising]].
ⓑ It was the store that he bought his new coat.
ⓒ It was oranges that I bought at the supermarket.
ⓓ It was James who broke the window last year.
ⓔ It is John who I don't understand.
ⓕ It was the boring lecture that [[make]] me fall asleep.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 주어인 a toothpaste가 '광고되는' 수동의 대상이므로 advertising을 (being) advertised로 고친다. ⓑ the store 앞에 장소를 나타내는 전치사 at이 생략되었다. ⓕ 과거시제이므로 make를 made로 고친다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 부분을 바르게 고친 것끼리 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.passage:
ⓐ It was Jenny [[which]] Peter breaks up with yesterday. → It was Jenny which Peter broke up with yesterday.
ⓑ It was in July that she [[sees]] fireworks at the park. → It was in July that she saw fireworks at the park.
ⓒ It is next week that Jane is moving out of town. → It is next week that Jane is [[moved]] out of town.
ⓓ It was [[bought]] that Sam a camera at the store yesterday. → Sam did buy a camera at the store yesterday.
ⓔ It was the man that she saw [[the man]] enter the house last night. → It was the man who she saw the man enter the house last night.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 강조하는 대상이 사람인 Jenny이므로 which를 사용할 수 없다. ⓒ Jane이 이사를 가는 것이므로 moving으로 고쳐야 한다. ⓔ 강조하고자 하는 대상을 It-that 사이에 넣었으므로 that 뒤에서는 삭제해야 한다.
